blocks.text:
Just like normal pointers, you can check whether a
`RefPtr` points to anything.
blocks.zh: 就像普通指针一样，你可以检查RefPtr是否指向了任何东西。

blocks.text:
But unlike normal pointers, `RefPtr`s are automatically
initialized to `nullptr` so you don't need to remember to do that yourself.
blocks.zh: 和普通指针不一样的是，RefPtr将会自动初始化为nullptr，不需要你自己进行置空。
